en.hubeali:
And from the two of them, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Al Wallad, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and someone else, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> both having said:
‘There is no problem with fee if the broker. But rather, he buys for the people day after day, with something known, and rather it is like the employee’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the two of them from ibn Mahbub from abu Wallad and others who has said the following: “They have said that abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Payment for brokerage fee to a broker who buys goods for people day after day is not unlawful.’”
